veranderings.voor: Hy het in 1944 by die ANC
veranderings.na: Mandela het in 1944 by die ANC
veranderings.rede: The block opens with 'Hy' right after a block whose subjects are the government and the groups, so naming Mandela makes the reference clear.
'Met protes help' reads wooden; helping with protests takes the countable plural in natural Afrikaans.
'n Ander' means 'a different' one; the sense of 'another, a further' trial is 'nog 'n' in Afrikaans.
Reaching an agreement in negotiation is 'ooreenkom'; 'saamstem' means sharing an opinion.
